'''Melvin R. Novick''' (September 21, 1932 – May 20, 1986) was an American statistician. He was a professor of Statistics at the [[University of Iowa]], and a consultant for the [[Educational Testing Service]] (ETS).<ref name="iowacitypresscitizenobit">{{cite news |title=Melvin R. Novick |url=https://www.newspapers.com/image/207317229/?terms=%22Melvin%2BR.%2BNovick%22 |access-date=October 26, 2018 |work=Iowa City Press-Citizen |date=May 22, 1986|page=3|via=[[Newspapers.com]]|url-access=registration }}</ref><ref name="angoffobit">{{cite journal |last1=Angoff |first1=William H.|author-link=William H. Angoff |title=Melvin R. Novick (1932-1986) |journal=American Psychologist |date=1987 |volume=42 |issue=7 |page=754 |doi=10.1037/h0090791}}</ref><ref name="linncontributions">{{cite journal |last1=Linn |first1=Robert L. |title=Melvin R. Novick: Contributions to the Theory and Practice of Educational and Psychological Measurement |journal=Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics |date=1987 |volume=12 |issue=1 |pages=11–20 |doi=10.3102/10769986012001011|s2cid=120367075 }}</ref>
